answer_1.quote: We investigate the dialogue-form interaction with LLMs in the context of text-to-image retrieval. Our proposed PlugIR progressively refines the text query for image retrieval using the dialogue between LLM questioner and the user.
answer_1.outputs: dialogue context, reformulated text queries, questions about images

answer_2.quote: We report the results mainly with two metrics: Hits@10 and our proposed BRI.

answer_3.quote: For each question generated by the questioner, we prompt an LLM agent to respond with "uncertain" if it cannot derive an answer from the corresponding description and dialogue, which implies the question is free from redundancy.

answer_4.quote: We engage 30 human testers to measure human preference for interactive text-to-image retrieval systems
answer_4.guideline: Q1. The system will be effective. (Yes: 5, No: 1) Q2. The system will be efficient. (Yes: 5, No: 1)
